title: GigCityElixir23 - Bryan Hunter
summary: Bryan Hunter's GigCityElixir 2023 talk on HCA Healthcare's Waterpark system, built on Elixir/Erlang. It describes how the architecture is distributed and fault-tolerant, with a multi-datacenter cluster and runtime code swapping.
why: HN recommends it as a rare real-world look at a large fault-tolerant Erlang/Elixir system with no downtime in healthcare.

quote.text: an excellent presentation of design/architecture of a Real-World fault-tolerant and distributed System in Erlang/Elixir
